context: Ongoing: Building the first three hip and knee actuators. This week: Carlos: kitting short three parts; spacers came in at the wrong length.

Ongoing: Whether the hip keeps the in-house cycloidal reducer or buys a harmonic drive for DVT. This week: Owen prices both: harmonic set ~$1.9k per joint and 10-week lead; cyclo is machined parts plus pins, ~3 weeks.
Ongoing: Coupling misalignment corrupting efficiency numbers on the dyno. This week: Andre: efficiency readings swing 4% between mounts of the same actuator.
